reverie.title: REVERIE — the peak where two voices learned the sky
narr: You stood with her on the high ground as the sun fell
two different ages learning to sing the same note. The sky
listened. Petals came down — not from any tree, but from
the air itself, answering. She laughed. You felt it first:
the moment sound became visible, the chorus learning to
leave its shape in the world. The sky still holds it.
